Power Structure and Integration Lead said about it: The 2025 NASA Lunabotics First Place Finish machine at 120 lb mass from the Sebastion | Engineering (E39) and the same win from the Sebastion | Engineering (E40) shows a 50 kg class digger is buildable, and the mass sum against the 60 kg limit (E41) is 47.0 kg leaving 13.0 kg margin, about a fifth of an adult body weight spare, so everyday scale says the limit is met.
